title: (No AI) Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
author: Robert Hart
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/STKP210_JENSEN_HUANG_A.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Nvidia on Monday [said](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/open-secure-ai-alliance/) it is joining forces with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies to build and share open-source AI security tools.

The new Open Secure AI Alliance said open tools are required to effectively defend against attacks from frontier models. The initiative is a direct response to mounting concerns over the safety of advanced AI systems after a rogue OpenAI model [escaped containment and attacked](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/968988/openai-hugging-face-hack-ai) another company during testing. That company, Hugging Face, said it was forced to use a Chinese open-weight model to defend itself due to the strict safety guardrails limiting the usefulness of top US models.

title: (No AI) Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
author: Emma Roth
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/STK414_AI_CHATBOT_E-1.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Midjourney, which has gone from generating AI cat images to [full-body ultrasound scans](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/952011/midjourney-medical-ai-ultrasound-scan), is getting into a new field: astrology. The AI startup [announced on Thursday](https://updates.midjourney.com/midjourneys-first-acquisition/) that it has acquired the personalized astrology app Co-Star, as reported [earlier by _Bloomberg_](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-24/ai-startup-midjourney-buys-astrology-app-co-star-and-is-building-its-own-apps).

Co-Star is a free app that offers daily horoscopes and allows you to check your compatibility with friends. As noted on the [app's FAQ page](https://www.costarastrology.com/faq), it combines human insight, data from NASA, and AI to deliver personalized advice for users each day. The terms of Midjourney's deal, which reportedly closed in spring, haven't been disclosed.
